summary: Add a new slash command /log-tension to .claude/commands/ that captures a named two-source conflict directly into brewmind-open-loops.md.
rationale: Section G of the companion contract requires recording tensions when two sources disagree, using a defined Tension: pattern. The current setup has no slash command for this — users must manually edit brewmind-open-loops.md, remember the exact pattern, and know which section to write to. In practice this friction means tensions go unrecorded. A dedicated /log-tension command would reduce the action to a single invocation.
proposed_diff_summary: Created .claude/commands/log-tension.md and registered /log-tension in CLAUDE.md command table.
decision_notes: Applied during skills assessment session. Command live at .claude/commands/log-tension.md.
